title: Creative Localization
description: Materialized localization for one creative. The creative's top-level `assets` are the source variant and every target carries buyer-supplied asset overrides; this contract never asks the receiving seller to generate or translate creative. `default_locale_variant_id` explicitly selects the fallback variant and may identify either the source or a target. Locale and locale_variant_id values MUST be unique within the creative, and no target locale may equal the source locale. A replacement is atomic: failure leaves the prior source assets and complete localization topology unchanged.

source.description: Identity and locale of the source variant. Its asset payload is the parent creative's top-level `assets` object. Source identifies production provenance; it is not implicitly the serving default.

locale_variant_id.description: Buyer-assigned stable identity for the source locale variant. This is a separate namespace from build_variant_id and served delivery variant_id.

target_variants.description: Complete desired target-locale set for this creative. Every target contains materialized locale-specific asset overrides. Missing slots inherit source assets; after inheritance every resolved variant MUST satisfy the selected creative format.

locale_variant_id.description: Buyer-assigned stable identity for this target locale variant. The same value round-trips through sync_creatives, list_creatives, and localized delivery reporting.

assets.description: Materialized locale-specific asset overrides keyed by the same slot IDs as the source creative. Missing slots inherit source assets.

default_locale_variant_id.description: The source or target locale_variant_id used when RFC 4647 Lookup finds no match and unmatched_locale_action is serve_default.

unmatched_locale_action.description: Required seller behavior when RFC 4647 Lookup finds no locale match. serve_default serves default_locale_variant_id; do_not_serve makes this creative ineligible for that opportunity.
